[h1]Release Date![/h1]
Cosmic Cursor will arrive on Steam on June 24th, 2024!

The game will include:

🚀 8 Unique Ships

👾 6 Complex Enemy Types

🃏  100+ Upgrade Cards

🤖 2 Devastating bosses

💎 17 Challenging Achievements

notes.title: Demo 3.0 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Major Demo Update[/h1]
This update has reworked and improved many of the core systems in the game.

[h2]Ship Rework[/h2]
Ships can now attack enemies in different ways.
The demo includes three new ship types, the Shotgun Ship, the Mine Ship, and the Shield Ship.
Only the Shield Ship retains the original slice to destroy attack pattern.

[h2]Upgrade Rework[/h2]
Progression has been reworked to include a shop based progression system.

[h2]Modifier Cards[/h2]
Modifier cards can be used to change how the game plays.

[h2]Mini Boss[/h2]
The demo also includes a mini boss to defeat!

notes.title: Demo 2.0 Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Ml1AJySclwM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Major Demo Update[/h1]
This update has reworked and improved many of the core systems in the game. Each ship now charges differently and has its own upgrades and progression.

The demo now includes:

🕚 Permanent Progression

🚀 3 Unique Ships

👾 6 Complex Enemy Types

🃏 70+ Upgrade Cards




[h1]Discord Server[/h1]
We also have a brand new Discord Server! Please join and give feedback on the game!

🌌 [url=https://discord.com/invite/VADFSNQuZ2]Cosmic Cursor Discord Server[/url]


[i]Cosmic Cursor is an arcade roguelike that combines kinetic melee-based combat with a dynamic bullet hell. Use the cursor to control a vast array of ships and survive increasingly complex enemy swarms as you battle through the cosmos.[/i]
